milestone.title: raul path tab + raul path CLI — swimlane rendering of mp path lanes

intent.outcome: raul renders the 4 mp path lanes as a swimlane TUI (path tab) plus a `raul path` CLI for humans not in the TUI. Execution/unblock lanes draw as connected chains; backlog draws as a priority-ordered queue. Colors per lane. Promotes idea ID-13. mp stays the JSON source of truth; raul reads mp path output read-only.

problem.description: raul has a dashboard/inbox and a review board (M84) but no path/lane view. Humans cannot see ordered work across execution/review/grooming/backlog in one visual. mp emits the lane JSON (M102) but there is no human rendering. ID-13 (rework Path lane: execution aside, separate lanes) is ripe now that M91 shipped and the lane model exists.

in_scope: raul TUI path tab: swimlane view of the 4 lanes (columns), distinct colors per lane, execution lane as connected chain, backlog as priority-ordered cards; reuses/generalizes M84 board rendering
raul path CLI: human-readable lane output reading mp path JSON
Lane headers + item cards with key fields (id, title, lifecycle/priority, blocked/needs_regrooming badges)
Keyboard navigation between lanes/items consistent with existing raul TUI keybindings
Empty-lane rendering (no crash; clear empty indicator)

design_decisions.choice: Swimlane (columns = lanes) rather than a pure dependency graph, generalizing the M84 review board
design_decisions.rationale: Only execution/grooming have real dep edges; review/backlog are queues. A swimlane renders ordered chains for the DAG lanes and ordered cards for queue lanes uniformly, and reuses existing board widgets.

design_decisions.choice: raul reads mp path JSON read-only and never computes ordering itself
design_decisions.rationale: mp is the single source of truth for ordering; raul is a view. Keeps the lane engine testable in isolation (M102) and raul testable against a frozen JSON contract.

findings.description: External review 2026-07-05 ER-1 (MAJOR): AC/finding integrity — 4 of 7 ACs (AC-01/02/03/05) are worded for the raul TUI path tab which was never implemented (crates/raul/src/tui/path_view.rs does not exist; tui/ has only app/dashboard/event/inbox_nav/markdown/mod/progress/render/runner). Findings F-01 (high: 'path_view.rs DOES NOT EXIST') and F-04 (high: 'AC-05 NOT IMPLEMENTED') closed status=fixed against e5d4089 — but git show --stat e5d4089 -- crates/ is empty (plan-only commit). Deferral is genuinely tracked (backlog B-62, ideas ID-26/ID-27) but the milestone record claims done. Fix: re-scope AC-01/02/03/05 to CLI-equivalent and file a TUI follow-up milestone, OR reopen F-01/F-04 until path_view.rs lands; AC evidence strings should not be identical across ACs.

findings.description: External review 2026-07-05 ER-2: backlog lane items rendered with bogus 'M' prefix. commands/path.rs:148 unconditionally does format!('M{} — {}', id, title). For execution/review/grooming lanes (milestone ids) correct; for the BACKLOG lane wrong — mp backlog_lane (path_engine.rs:749,773) emits ids like 'B-43'/'BF-01'. CLI renders 'MB-43'. Fix: branch on lane item_type / item['type'] ('backlog-item' vs 'milestone'); drop M prefix for backlog items.
findings.author: external-review

findings.description: External review 2026-07-05 ER-3: no automated test for raul path --all / --lane. tests/path.rs covers only raul next and legacy raul path (no flags). No test exercises --all, --lane <name>, empty-lane rendering, or single-lane response shape (path.rs:91-94). AC-04/AC-06 verified with manual evidence only. findings.author: external-review

findings.description: External review 2026-07-05 ER-4: no JSON-shape contract pin between mp path and raul reads::path_lanes. reads.rs:39-48 hands raw serde_json::Value to commands::path::path_lanes which indexes with unwrap_or('?')/unwrap_or(0). If M102 changes the lane shape, raul won't panic — it will silently print ? and 0 across every lane. F-05 filed a frozen-contract pin (tests/contract/path_lanes_schema.json) and was closed fixed against e5d4089; the file does not exist. Fix: commit a frozen lane-shape fixture + a deserialize test against a LaneShape struct.
findings.author: external-review

findings.description: External review 2026-07-05 ER-6: find_mp sibling-preference probe checks sibling.is_file() but not the executable bit. mp_runner.rs:43-48. A non-executable file named 'mp' next to raul (stale build artifact, symlink to removed target, botched cp) satisfies is_file() and is returned, then fails at Command::new().output() time with generic 'failed to run mp' error rather than falling through to MP_HOME/PATH. Fix: on unix check mode & 0o111 != 0; if sibling exists but isn't executable, log and continue.
findings.author: external-review
